Port Coquitlam lots and land for sale: vacant land and building lots on the MLS®. Zoning decides what can be built, so check the zone and the City’s plans for the exact lot before you offer. Across all home types the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark in Port Coquitlam was $835,500 in September 2026.
Port Coquitlam lots and land sold, November 2025 to October 2026
Fewer than 3 lots and land sold in Port Coquitlam, too few to describe.
When so few sell, one sale is the whole picture, so this page does not quote a typical price. Ask Jared for the recent sales near the address you are looking at.

blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Port Coquitlam: the all home types benchmark was $835,500 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 8.2%; over three months it fell 5.9%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.6%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.6%; over 5 years it was little changed (+1.4%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 48.4%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: Is Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Port Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 24%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many lots and land are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the lots and land in Port Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when lots and land come up in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Port Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Port Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Port Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
